values.note: 2026 rates for 2 adults and 2 children: water/electric site $40 a night, full hookup $45 (primitive tent site $35). Extra adults $5 a night; air conditioner or electric heater use $3 a day; optional $5 lock fee to guarantee a site number. Deposit of one night, nonrefundable; cancellations under 7 days pay in full. Read 2026-10-20.

note: Privately owned (the operator says so explicitly) 44-acre wooded park at 3075 E 2nd St on US 6 at the top of Denton Hill, 8 mi east of Coudersport across from the State Police barracks - despite the name it is not a county park. 105 campsites including 15 camping cabins; the operator's campground-map PDF shows numbered water/electric and water/electric/sewer drive-in pads (sites 1-105) on two long loops off the access road, plus primitive tent sites, heated bathhouses with private showers, camp store, dump station, honey-wagon service and a rentable pavilion. 2026 nightly rates $35 primitive / $40 water-electric / $45 full hookup, cabins $58-128. The operator says it is open year-round (its April 1 - September 30 dates are for the rental camper only); direct access to the state ATV and snowmobile trail systems (ATV trails Memorial Day weekend to the last full weekend in September). Online booking through ResNexus. RV Life 4*/$$ ~$38/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 water/electric base and $45 full hookup (2026), water+sewer hookups, 90 non-cabin sites, showers/dump/store, ResNexus online booking. Changed season Apr 1-Sep 30 -> year-round (the operator says 'Open Year Round!'; the Apr-Sep dates were the rental camper's) and corrected the note.
